# Stat

Headline metric block — the "four metrics that matter" row and workflow timings.

`InfoquestDesignSystem_80b250.Stat` · Content

## Use

```jsx

```


## Notes

Headline metric: small label, big purple value, bold caption, optional description ("Speed / <2 hrs / Expert list delivery").
